fields.description: Issue includes extensive coverage of alleged abuses at the Miami Retreat and criticism of psychiatrist Dr. T. Earl Moore ("Torture Doctor"), urging grand jury and state medical board action; commentary on Florida Power & Light and municipal ownership in Miami city elections; discussion of anti-gambling campaigns and legalized pari-mutuel racing; local government and civic news including Miami municipal court activity tied to alcohol offenses, a Coral Way zoning dispute, and public health warnings about DDT spraying; notices and promotion for a Dade County Coconut Harvest Festival at Crandon Park, along with columns, letters to the editor, and advertisements.
